name: SmartJose AI Auto Post Generator
author: rousse44

sections.description:
SmartJose AI Auto Post Generator creates native WordPress posts from an administrator-supplied topic or a topic queue.

The WordPress.org edition includes manual article generation with OpenAI and Google Gemini and does not impose a monthly article quota. Your AI provider may charge for API usage under its own terms.

Included in the WordPress.org edition:

  • OpenAI Responses API with structured output.
  • Google Gemini structured output.
  • Native WordPress posts, categories, tags, excerpts and slugs.
  • Automatic table of contents built from final H2/H3 headings.
  • Draft, pending-review or publish workflow.
  • A manual topic queue with duplicate-topic checks before an AI request is sent.
  • Local logs with API-key-like values redacted.
  • No custom AI proxy and no executable code downloaded from external services.

A separately distributed Pro version adds code for three additional AI providers, OpenAI-generated JPG featured images, verified same-site internal linking, custom editorial instructions, Yoast SEO / Rank Math metadata integration and WP-Cron Autopilot. Premium implementation code is removed from the WordPress.org package.

The plugin uses your own provider API keys. AI requests are sent directly from your WordPress server to the external provider selected by an administrator.

External services

This WordPress.org edition can connect to the following external services after an administrator saves an API key and chooses a provider.

OpenAI
* Endpoint: https://api.openai.com/v1/responses
* Data sent: administrator topic/keywords, language, the plugin-generated prompt and article-generation settings.
* Purpose: generate the requested article content.
* Policy / terms: https://openai.com/policies/

Google Gemini
* Endpoint: https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/
* Data sent: administrator topic/keywords, language, the plugin-generated prompt and article-generation settings.
* Purpose: generate the requested article content.
* Policy / terms: https://ai.google.dev/terms

Freemius
* Service: optional account/consent flow, Pro upgrade checkout and optional product analytics when the administrator consents through the SDK flow.
* The plugin does not send AI API keys or generated article content to Freemius.
* Policy / terms: https://freemius.com/privacy/ and https://freemius.com/terms/

AI API keys are stored in the WordPress database with autoload disabled and are not printed back into the settings form after saving. Administrators should protect database backups and rotate any key that may have been exposed.
sections.installation:
1. Upload and activate the plugin.
  2. Open SmartJose AI > Settings.
  3. Choose OpenAI or Gemini, enter the model and API key, then save.
  4. Use Test active provider.
  5. Open Generate and create the first article as a draft.
sections.faq:
Does the WordPress.org edition limit the number of articles I can generate?

No. The plugin does not impose a monthly article quota. Your selected AI provider may charge for API requests according to its own pricing and limits.

Are AI keys sent to the plugin author?

No. AI API requests go directly from your WordPress server to the selected provider. Freemius is separate from the AI request path.

Which AI providers are included in the WordPress.org package?

OpenAI and Google Gemini. The separately distributed Pro version contains code for additional providers.

Does the WordPress.org package generate featured images?

No. Featured-image generation is implemented in the separately distributed Pro version and its implementation is not included in the WordPress.org package.

Can it auto-publish on a schedule?

The WordPress.org package supports manual generation and lets you choose Draft, Pending Review or Publish for each generated post. Scheduled WP-Cron Autopilot is implemented in the separately distributed Pro version.
sections.changelog:
1.1.8

  • Final Plugin Check cleanup after live repository-category test.
  • Placed the plural-string translator note directly on the translation call.
  • Documented the centralized raw POST accessor for the sanitization sniff; every caller sanitizes or validates by field type.

1.1.7

  • WordPress.org Plugin Check compatibility pass.
  • Centralized nonce-protected admin form access and documented read-only navigation input.
  • Added translator context for the pluralized queue message.
  • Removed the obsolete manual text-domain loader.
  • Documented exception-message handling so static analysis does not confuse exceptions with HTML output.
  • Retained Freemius-generated integration identifiers for upgrade compatibility with a narrow coding-standard annotation.

1.1.6

  • Introduced the SmartJose product name and aligned the WordPress.org slug/text domain.
  • Removed all plugin-imposed monthly article quotas from the WordPress.org edition.
  • Moved featured-image generation entirely to the separately distributed Pro code package.
  • Marked the image generator and other Pro implementation files for removal from Freemius-generated Free packages.
  • Removed legacy quota checks, counters and quota-based UI.
  • Simplified the in-plugin Pro promotion for a cleaner WordPress.org submission.
  • Aligned the plugin/readme name and updated WordPress.org metadata for WordPress 7.1.

1.1.5

  • Rebranded the admin-facing product name before the WordPress.org compatibility pass.
